description: Nesting-depth boundary of the persona-binary reader (docs/SCHEMA.md §3.4 rule 2): 1000 nested array/map levels decode, 1001 are rejected. The schemas nest single-element array types; they are given as generatedSchema because a 1000-level type tree is deeper than a JSON parser should be fed (see vectors/README.md).

vectors.description: 1000 nested single-element arrays around an int decode: exactly at the limit, which §3.4 rule 2 must accept. The encoding is 1000 block headers (02 = zigzag(1)), the int 1, then 1000 zero terminators.
1001 nested arrays exceed the 1000-level limit and are rejected before the deepest element is read.
